limitations: total_words only exists where a transcript was analysed (ta-v1); silent/no-speech reels are absent from this chart entirely, not at zero. The analysis-ready corpus is not a random sample of the niche: deep.py only ever processed reels that score.py had already ranked near the top of their creator's output, so its median robust_z is above zero by construction. Any contrast computed inside it compares strong videos with other strong videos, not strong with average (docs/M2RADAR_ANALYSIS_METHOD.md §1.4).
method: Scatter of total script word count against robust_z, one point per code with both values.
title: Script length vs performance
